description.value:
Frequency once per day

Range 30 feet

The whole job was always getting them back out. The rest was detail.

Every dying ally you can see stabilises at 1 Hit Point and stands if able. Every unconscious ally you can see wakes. You take 3d6 damage for each creature affected, which cannot be prevented, reduced, or redirected, and you may not use this if it would reduce you to 0 Hit Points.

cinderfall.incomplete: Every dying ally stabilizes at 1 HP and stands, every unconscious ally wakes, and the caster takes 3d6 per creature affected. No rule-element key ends the dying/unconscious condition on a different creature (matches pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/actions/class/champion/liberating-step.json's own unencoded shape for the closest real analog -- confirming the effect-class ships unencoded, but providing no actual hook to reach for). The self-damage-scaled-by-count clause is moot without the condition-removal half.
